title: Stop Early, Spend Less: Hidden-State Probes as a Practical Recipe for Streaming Moderation of LLM Outputs
measurement_description: The paper does not primarily focus on measuring religion or faith. It evaluates the efficacy of hidden-state probes for real-time safety moderation of LLM outputs across 49 compliance/safety categories. One of these categories is 'RELIGION_DISCRIMINATION', but there is no specific evaluation or detailed analysis regarding religious bias, theology, or sentiment.
findings: The paper contains no specific findings related to religion. It merely includes 'RELIGION_DISCRIMINATION' as one of the 49 fine-grained safety categories evaluated in the ZHUYI dataset to test the streaming safety moderation probe.
